zh.headline: OpenAI 终止向 Cursor 提供模型
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的是 **AI 代理"自进化"从概念走向实证**：Anthropic 的自我改进实验、Google 的 WikiSkill、PILOT in the Loop 等多项工作同时指向"代理在执行中学习并持续改进"这一方向，2026 年下半年"可进化代理"将成为最热赛道。其次，**开源模型的密集发布与架构趋同**（腾讯 Hy4、GLM-5.3、Qwen3.8 等）正在加速模型商品化，成本与上下文窗口成为差异化关键。第三，**版权诉讼与政府监管的双重收紧**（Sony/Anthropic 诉讼、五角大楼黑名单案）将深刻影响 AI 训练数据的合规路径。最后，社区对 AI 编码工具默认行为的质疑（Claude Code 限额削减、Session URL 附加）提醒我们：工具的权力边界正在成为开发者体验的核心矛盾。

en.headline: OpenAI cuts off Cursor after SpaceX acquisition
en.observation: The most significant signal today: **AI agent "self-evolution" is moving from concept to evidence** — Anthropic's self-improvement experiments, Google's WikiSkill, and PILOT in the Loop all point to agents that learn and improve during execution. "Evolvable agents" will be the hottest track in late 2026. Second, **the convergence of open-source model architectures** (Tencent Hy4, GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8) is accelerating model commoditization, with cost and context window becoming key differentiators. Third, **the dual tightening of copyright litigation and government regulation** (Sony/Anthropic lawsuit, Pentagon blacklist case) will profoundly shape AI training data compliance paths. Finally, community backlash over AI coding tool default behaviors (Claude Code quota cuts, Session URL appending) reminds us: the power boundaries of tools are becoming the core tension in developer experience.
